items.title: Portfolio SPA – Vanilla JavaScript
items.description: Single Page Application built without frameworks to consolidate Front-End fundamentals. Implemented routing with the History API, dynamic rendering from JSON, and a modular architecture using ES6 modules. Includes a theming system (dark/light) with CSS custom properties.

items.title: SuperM – React E-commerce SPA
items.description: E-commerce application built with React and Vite. Implemented user authentication, a persistent cart, and global state management. Data is fetched via Supabase with optimized rendering for a consistent user experience.

items.title: Social Network SPA – React Front-End
items.description: React Single Page Application with authentication, a dynamic feed, and interaction system (likes, follows). Front-End focused: state management, routing, and a responsive user experience on top of an existing API.
